ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what do green sea turtles eat?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram is titled “FOOD WEB.” The label “Green Sea Turtle” appears near the lower left. Directly below it is “Turtle Grass,” with an arrow pointing upward from Turtle Grass to Green Sea Turtle. Reasoning: In this food web, arrows show the direction from the food/resource to the organism that eats it. Since the arrow goes from Turtle Grass to Green Sea Turtle, green sea turtles eat turtle grass.
